children: Stitch Fix is getting more out of fewer clients. Net revenue per active client rose 7.8% year-over-year to $592 in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, the company said. Active clients, however, fell 1.4% to 2.277 million over the same period. The online personal styling service is extracting higher spending from its remaining user base as it works through a transformation strategy. Full-year revenue grew 6.4% to $1.35 billion, and the company said it gained market share in the U.S. apparel, footwear and accessories market.
